manifest_app_id_description: Only with an App ID and Access Token from the old console: then the API Key field above holds the Access Token.
manifest_asr_model_description: The model must be turned on in the Doubao Speech console.
manifest_description: Transcribe meetings on the hub and read answers aloud when Persona takes part in a meeting, with your Volcengine (Doubao Speech) account. Paste an API Key and turn on Use for Meeting Transcription.
manifest_key_description: Copy it from API Key管理 (API Keys) in the Doubao Speech console. Saving tests recognition and synthesis once.
manifest_meetings_confirm: New meetings will transcribe on the hub by default: their audio goes to Volcengine as it's recorded, and the hub deletes it once the minutes are written.
manifest_meetings_description: New meetings transcribe on the hub by default, with Volcengine. This is the same choice as the transcription service in Recording settings.
manifest_read_answers_description: When Persona takes part in a meeting, its answers are read in the voice below. When this is off, or on an error, the phone's own voice reads them.
manifest_voice_id_description: A voice ID copied from the voice library (音色库) in the Doubao Speech console; used instead of the voice above.
